name: Concert
description: A weekly concert in one lobby: a performer model, its motion and a song, seen and heard by Caelum players. The files come from a server modpack.

lobby.label: Lobby
lobby.description: Lobby name (LOBBY1 .. LOBBY20 or a name from caelum-lobbies.txt) or its number (0-19 stock lobbies, 20-63 Caelum extra lobbies).

weekday.label: Day
weekday.description: Day of the week the concert starts.

hour.label: Start hour
hour.description: Hour of the start, 0-23 (server clock, see Extensions time zone).

duration_minutes.label: Length (minutes)
duration_minutes.description: How long the performer and song stay.

prefetch_minutes.label: Load ahead (minutes)
prefetch_minutes.description: Players' games load the model this long before the start.

warn_first_minutes.label: First announcement (minutes before)
warn_first_minutes.description: Server-wide announcement this long before the start. 0: none.

warn_second_minutes.label: Second announcement (minutes before)
warn_second_minutes.description: Another announcement this long before the start. 0: none.

model.label: Performer model (BML file)
model.description: Required. A BML archive from a server modpack.

model_part.label: Model inside the BML
model_part.description: Name of the model file inside the BML. Empty: the first.

motion.label: Motion file
motion.description: Animation (NJM) inside the BML. Empty: no motion.

music.label: Song (ADX file)
music.description: Music played during the concert. Empty: no music.

x.label: Position X
x.description: Stand on the spot and type $xyz to read X, Y and Z.

rot_y.label: Turn (degrees)
rot_y.description: Which way the performer faces, -360 to 360.

announce.label: Start announcement
announce.description: Sent to everyone when the concert starts.
announce.default: A concert is starting in the concert lobby!
